comment: Shared by src/core/internal/compose/vectors_test.go and tests/test_simulated.py: what the core answers for each input, so the simulated host's stand-ins (tests/support/simulated_core.py) are checked against the core. Inputs are written by hand; `go test ./internal/compose -run TestVectors -update` rewrites the answers.

request.yaml:
proxies:
  - {name: 香港 01, type: http, server: a, port: 1}
proxy-groups:
  - {name: 节点选择, type: select, proxies: [香港 01]}
  - {name: 媒体, type: url-test, proxies: [节点选择, 香港 01]}
rules:
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,a.example,媒体
  - DOMAIN,b.example,媒体
  - RULE-SET,ads,REJECT
  - PROCESS-NAME,ssh,DIRECT
  - MATCH,节点选择

proxies:
  - {name: 香港 01, type: http, server: a, port: 1}
proxy-groups:
  - {name: 媒体, type: select, proxies: [DIRECT]}
rules:
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,a.example,媒体
  - DOMAIN,b.example,媒体
  - RULE-SET,ads,REJECT
  - PROCESS-NAME,ssh,DIRECT
  - MATCH,媒体
